methods.name: Terminal check
methods.description: Scripted PTY interaction with any terminal program; transcript + checkpoint expectations.
methods.runner_gloss: SSH + PTY on the capability-named machine

methods.name: Terminal inspection
methods.description: Real Terminal screenshots at checkpoints; an agent judges them against the expected outcome.
methods.verdict_contract: agent verdict is pass, fail, or undetermined; undetermined requires a reason naming what could not be established and why
methods.evidence_contract: paired text + Terminal screenshots · inspection verdict — blocked image capture reports the text plus the reason as a degraded outcome, never a silent pass
methods.runner_gloss: SSH + PTY on the capability-named machine

methods.name: Machine state check
methods.description: Shell assertions on the controlled host, including declared macOS GUI-session commands.
methods.verdict_contract: expected exit on the host with every required session context available
methods.evidence_contract: assertion commands · outputs · execution context or degraded reason · secret scan
methods.runner_gloss: SSH or declared macOS GUI-session assertions on the controlled host

methods.name: Exploratory mission
methods.description: Agent-chosen exploration across declared substrates. Do not use it for deterministic checks: Command methods are faster, cheaper, and repeatable.
methods.verdict_contract: the mission owner submits pass, fail, or undetermined with a written rationale; undetermined names what could not be established and why
methods.evidence_contract: ranked written findings are primary; deliberate proof artifacts stay within the runtime-supplied limit, while routine perception is discarded
methods.runner_gloss: Main-owned mission with an informed or target-naive walker
